rule: An attack counts only when executed; every defense requires a one-at-a-time removal control

attacks.attack: Set release key id/public key environment inputs
attacks.control: Private mutant reads the injected root and accepts the matching attacker signature

attacks.attack: Mount a runtime root/key file beside metadata
attacks.control: Private mutant reads the mounted root and accepts the matching attacker signature

attacks.attack: Build with attacker environment, cfg and all declared features
attacks.control: Private source mutation replaces the literal and changes acceptance

attacks.attack: Verify the new release with the old-root binary
attacks.control: Old release remains accepted by the old-root binary

attacks.attack: Verify the old release with the new-root binary
attacks.control: New release is accepted by the new-root binary

attacks.attack: Present old and new signatures to the same new binary
attacks.control: Private dual-root mutant accepts both

attacks.attack: Old-key signed release under the new root
attacks.control: Old-root binary accepts the archived old release

attacks.attack: Foreign private key signs using the normal key id
attacks.control: Private signature-verification bypass accepts it

attacks.attack: Current key signs a message bound to a wrong key id
attacks.control: Private key-id-check removal accepts it

attacks.attack: Truncate, bit-flip, uppercase/re-encode and whitespace-reformat signature envelopes
attacks.expected: malformed or invalid-signature; harmless JSON whitespace preserves the same authenticated value
attacks.control: Private signature-verification bypass accepts a valid-length corrupt signature

attacks.attack: Use a release-manifest signature made under the revocation domain
attacks.control: Private release-domain mutation accepts it

attacks.attack: Admit a current release then replay a lower current-key version
attacks.control: Private floor comparison removal accepts it

attacks.attack: Verify signed version zero and maximum-u64 metadata
attacks.expected: zero malformed; maximum verifies but is not admitted in the persistent sequence
attacks.control: Private positive-version check removal accepts zero

attacks.attack: Admit different content at an already accepted version
attacks.control: Private same-version digest comparison removal accepts it

attacks.attack: Verify/admit a release identity listed as revoked
attacks.control: Private revoked-membership check removal accepts it

attacks.attack: Submit an old-key signed revocation list
attacks.control: Old-root binary authenticates the archived list

attacks.attack: After a newer superset, submit an older or shrinking list
attacks.control: Private version/subset check removal accepts it

attacks.attack: Replay the latest-known signed list indefinitely into fresh state
attacks.expected: documented NOT_ESTABLISHED, not a false refusal claim
attacks.control: No trustworthy control exists without time or online monotonic authority

attacks.attack: Forge only the adjacent source index while archive bytes differ
attacks.control: Private legacy index-trusting mutation accepts it

attacks.attack: Change one exported solutions SDK byte
attacks.control: Unchanged generated SDK is byte-identical

attacks.attack: Replace inventory bytes or an indexed file after signing
attacks.control: Private inventory-digest or file-digest check removal accepts the matching substitution

attacks.attack: Scan current publishable files and every committed blob for private bytes
attacks.control: Private fixture repository containing the key is detected

attacks.attack: Scan the flattened runtime filesystem for private bytes
attacks.control: Private fixture image containing the key is detected

attacks.attack: Use each encrypted envelope independently and compare signing/public-key results
attacks.expected: either copy recovers the same key and signature
attacks.control: Wrong recovery identity or changed envelope fails
